page0.text:
"Hup...!"
I match the repeated attacks from the long sword with a long sword.
The swords offset each other, and the fragments are sent flying into the atmosphere.

page1.text:
"Hey, don't..."
The handle of a curved sword appears behind him.
"...Get ahead of yourself, kid...!"
But I'm faster...
I pull out the curved sword at his feet and swing it straight at him...!

page2.text:
"Ungh!"
Gilgamesh retreats.
I close the distance at once, pull out the sword, and slash at him.

page3.text:
"Guh, why...!?
Why am I losing to this mongrel's sword...!?"
I match my sword to the rapid successions of Noble Phantasms.

page4.text:
"Haah... Haah, haah, haah, haah...!"
I'm not thinking.
My body and mind will stop if I stop.
I will keep moving forward now.
The instant I see his Noble Phantasm, I reel in the same one that I have at hand, and strike him down with all my might...!

page5.text: "Impossible... Am I being cornered by such a sham...!?"

page6.text:
"Ungh, hnng...!"
The sounds of clashing swords echo through the area.
He cannot handle my attacks and has to destroy my weapon with his.

page7.text:
That will be the cause of his defeat.
Having over 1000 Noble Phantasms, he is the greatest Heroic Spirit without a doubt.

page8.text:
But, he is no more than an owner.
He is not a wielder who only has one Noble Phantasm but is able to use that to its fullest potential.

page9.text:
If my opponent was another Servant, I would not be able to match them even if I made a world like this.
Even if I have infinite swords, I can't beat an enemy who has a single ultimate Noble Phantasm.
I'm sure Gilgamesh would be able to, but I don't have enough physical ability to.

page10.text:
Therefore... The only Servant that I can close in on is this man.
If we have the same ability and are both owners, I'll go a step ahead of him since I already have swords prepared...!

page11.text:
"Dammit... Dammit, dammit dammit dammit dammit dammit...!!! I did not think I would have to use my sword against someone like you...!"
Gilgamesh raises his arm.
The hilt that appears behind him is that demonic sword, the only sword that does not exist in this world...!

page12.text:
"I won't let you...!"
"Guh...!?"
I swing my twin swords.
I immediately draw Kanshou and Bakuya and cut off his arm as it reaches for his magical sword...!

page13.text:
"Wha—"
The weapons come to a halt.
He loses his best sword and is left completely defenseless.

page14.text:
"Hup...!"
My body acts before I can think.
With victory assured, my arms and legs drive me into the King of Heroes' space even more sharply to slice his body in two...!

page15.text:
"...Guh!"
He jumps back.
Gilgamesh retreats, barely dodging my twin swords.

page16.text:
"Khh... At this moment, you are stronger than me...!"
Gilgamesh admits his defeat and tries to retreat.

page17.text:
"I'm not letting you get away."
I'll lose if he regains his composure. I have to settle the match at this moment before this heat cools down...!
"Bastard...!"

page18.text:
"Crap...!"
He must've realized that he would not be able to escape, as he pulls out a Noble Phantasm from behind him with his remaining arm.
But I'm faster.
Meanwhile, I'll surely...

page19.text:
"...Huh?"
"What...?"
Our voices overlap.
That change is instant.

page20.text:
The flash of light coming from the lake eliminates the hill of swords.
The massive magical energy wiped away the already disappearing Reality Marble.

page21.text:
That's fine.
The match is settled.
I can defeat this Servant just by swinging these twin swords.
But after that...

page22.text:
A black hole.
A round void big enough to swallow a human whole...
appears before me... On Gilgamesh's body.

page23.text:
"Wh...at?"
Gilgamesh looks down at his own body, appalled.
...His body is being swallowed.
The golden Servant is being swallowed up by the hole that has opened inside him.

page24.text:
"Wa—"
Did he want to say "wait?"
The void mercilessly swallows the Servant.
...There was no way for him to escape.
The void was opened in his own body after all.
There's no way he can escape from something that is in his body.

page25.text:
"...What was... that?"
I stand there, dumbfounded.
The void in front of me gets smaller by the moment.

page26.text:
...I don't know what this is.
But it seems like Tohsaka and Saber were able to destroy the Holy Grail.
My only guess is that this black void appeared from that effect and he vanished.

page27.text:
"...Phew. Anyways, now..."
Everything is over.
The twin swords disappear.
The magical energy occupying my body rapidly fades, and at the same time...
"Oh... Shoot."
Fatigue assails me.
"...Damn. This is bad, I can't walk."
I want to go see how Tohsaka's doing right away, but my body won't move.
...Well, I'm sure she's doing fine since Saber went to her.
"...Right. I guess..."
I can rest a bit.
And the moment I take a deep breath...
"Wha—!?"
A chain wraps around my arm.

page28.text:
"Guh...!"
My breath stops.
The chain that's mercilessly wrapped around my arm pulls me towards the black hole...!

page29.text:
"Agh, khh...!"
I put strength in my limbs, but I can't resist at all.
My feet slide towards the void along with the very ground they are planted on...!

page30.text:
"Khh... That fool, does he not even know that Servants cannot become the core...!?"
"You...!"

page31.text:
The thing crawling from the void was definitely him.
But... That body has melted here and there.
That void must melt anything it swallows...!

page32.text:
"Khh, you little...!"
I try to pull the chain off of me, but it doesn't budge.
This chain restrained even Berserker. It's not something that I can take off no matter how hard I try...!

page33.text:
"Agh, guh..."
I'm getting drawn in...!
I'll be swallowed like him if I go near that void...!

page34.text:
"Damn, are you trying to take me with you...!?"
"You fool, I have no intention of dying...!
Stay right there until I pull myself out, you lowlife!"
"You...!"
He's so arrogant even in a situation like this...!

page35.text:
"Ah... Khh, damn..."
But, what should I do?
I can't get the chain off no matter what I do.
I'll fall into the void along with him like this.
Even if I hold out, he'll pull himself out then.

page36.text: It means I'm going to die either way...
